name: PATHS (University of Utah)
org: University of Utah, Continuing and Community Engagement
what_you_do: A 4 year college access program for first generation students. Each year you join 2 weeks of summer camp. You also get monthly workshops and weekly online mentoring and tutoring.
who_can_apply: Current 8th graders who will start high school in the fall and are first-generation college students (no parent finished college in the U.S.). No minimum GPA. Plan to join for all 4 years.
pay_detail: Free. Lunch and rides are provided. A one-time $15 registration fee is due if you are accepted (tell the team if that is a problem).
duration: 4 years. Two weeks of summer camp each year.
deadline_text: The page does not post the priority deadline yet. No dates are posted for the next group.
how_to_apply: Apply online with essay answers. A committee picks students.
notes: The page text looks old (it lists a May 30, 2022 deadline). Email or call before you plan around it. For 8th graders only, so it is for students about to start 9th grade.
